title: DVAPI
summary: All 10 OWASP API Security Top 10 challenges solved, from JWT forgery to SSRF.

card.caption: All 10 API Top 10 challenges solved in about three hours.

did: The JWT secret fell to offline cracking in seconds, which allowed forging an admin token. NoSQL injection on login bypassed authentication entirely.
Also covered object-level and function-level authorization flaws, mass assignment, and SSRF used to probe internal services.
results: A weak JWT secret can be cracked offline to forge an admin token, and URL parameters without an allowlist open SSRF.
next: Use a high-entropy JWT secret, sanitize NoSQL input and apply an egress allowlist.
